environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with direct TCP passthrough on port 443. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with db user 'appuser' granted SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables. No query inspection middleware. Application runs as container on ECS Fargate with awsvpc networking.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, appuser has full DML privileges
config.network: ECS Fargate awsvpc, security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0
config.db_user_permissions: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO appuser
